entries.dc4254dd59d565e6: Under the vision of “Life-long Ink”, the company is promoting its medium-term management plan “Wacom Chapter 4”. Working to enhance and integrate its element technologies to deliver technological innovation that realizes new “kaku” experiences, the company is evolving its business model as a “tool maker” that delivers comprehensive experiences across all forms of “kaku” in four use-case areas: “Create”, “Learn/Teach”, “Work/Play and Beyond”, and “Live More Human”. In addition to hardware sales, the company is building new revenue models based on data and services.
